import bpy,numpy as np,hashlib
def object_hash(o):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    h.update(np.array(o.matrix_world, dtype=np.float32).tobytes())
    for v in o.data.vertices:
        h.update(np.array(v.co, dtype=np.float32).tobytes())
    for p in o.data.polygons:
        h.update(np.array(p.vertices, dtype=np.int32).tobytes())
    for uv in o.data.uv_layers:
        a = np.empty(len(uv.data) * 2, np.float32)
        uv.data.foreach_get('uv', a)
        h.update(a.tobytes())
    h.update('|'.join((m.name for m in o.data.materials if m)).encode())
    return h.hexdigest()
bpy.app.driver_namespace['work15']['object_hash']=object_hash
